Overview

The hidden cost of Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Energy & Utilities is never the model; it is the scaffolding — data contracts, evaluation harnesses, rollback machinery, audit evidence. We price and build that scaffolding explicitly, on SCADA / EMS cores, because that is where programs actually succeed or die. The Energy & Utilities operating reality gives this work its shape: grid state pressure at event speed, NERC CIP standards obligations on every artifact, and practitioners who will not accept recommendations they cannot interrogate. The pattern below is calibrated to those three forces.
